limits: 004/116 show five small windows, pale splayed stone jambs/sills and top-open historic wall notches. They do not identify the interior rooms.
Centres follow the five existing facade bay candidates; offsets and dimensions are not surveyed.
P06 photo116 camera gives incompatible glass-head locations on trial depth planes: not accepted as a metric window fit.
OSM historic wall diverges from model facade; long reveal depth bridges this unresolved registration gap. Depth is particularly uncertain, not an as-built construction detail.
104 does not document these nonpublic rooms; no interior room geometry is invented. Opening operation removes only the local R27 lower facade and R35 historic wall context.
